member.name: T:ExxerCube.Prisma.Infrastructure.Database.EfCoreUnifiedMetadataStore
member.summary: EF Core implementation of . Persists and retrieves the consolidated as a JSON payload in the UnifiedMetadataRecords table, keyed by file identifier.

remarks.para: Serialisation: contains SmartEnum (-derived) members. The local is included in the serialiser options so that enum members round-trip correctly via their stable Name string (identical to the strategy in the Infrastructure.FileSystem handoff store).

Cross-infrastructure isolation: To avoid introducing a project reference from Infrastructure.Database to Infrastructure (which would violate the no-cross-infra rule), the converter factory is re-implemented as an internal class within this file. The logic is identical; the class name differs to satisfy the architecture duplicate-name guard.
Fault tolerance: Every public method is fail-open — persistence errors are logged and returned as failures, never thrown.
